definitions.explanation: Strong mental fortitude and perseverance. The ability to push through difficulties without giving up.
A person's fundamental character or nature, often used in a negative sense to describe an unpleasant disposition.

examples.japanese: {根性|こんじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
{根性|こんじょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{走|はし}り→走る：00519_hashiru⟧きった。
examples.english: I ran all the way to the end through sheer willpower.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{根性|こんじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧あきらめない。
examples.english: That athlete has determination, so they won't give up easily.

examples.japanese: {根性|こんじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
⟦あいつ→あいつ：08267_aitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{根性|こんじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{曲|ま}がっている→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧。
examples.english: That guy has a twisted personality.

examples.japanese: {根性|こんじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{腐|くさ}った→腐る：02049_kusaru⟧⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}いたくない→付き合う：02291_tsukiau⟧。
examples.english: I don't want to associate with people who have a rotten character.

notes: Sense 1 is positive, praising perseverance and fighting spirit. Common collocations: {根性|こんじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have guts), {根性|こんじょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{頑張|がんば}る→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧ (to persevere through willpower). Sense 2 is negative, describing someone's unpleasant character. Common collocations: {根性|こんじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (bad-natured), {根性|こんじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{曲|ま}がっている→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧ (twisted nature), {根性|こんじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{腐|くさ}っている→腐る：02049_kusaru⟧ (rotten character). The compound {根性論|こんじょうろん} refers to the belief that willpower alone can overcome any challenge.
